title.narrative: Justice for All through University and Professional Sustainable Service Delivery, Teaching and Training (JUST)

description.narrative:
**Long term impact: Rule of Law** Strengthened: Citizens are better able to access their rights through fair, efficient, impartial, independent and accountable institutions
Contribute to promoting just, peaceful and inclusive societies and achieving legitimate stability (SDG 16) through strengthening of capacity, knowledge and quality of individuals as well as organisations in the fields of Technical and Vocational Education and Training and Higher Education (TVET/HE) in OKP partner countries.
**Outcome(s) to be achieved at project level**
SoL, ILPD, CILC and VU Amsterdam perform better their core tasks, firmly embedded in their environment (in line with country/ regional specific labour market needs & aiming at inclusiveness) Enhanced application of knowledge and skills of alumni of the participating institutions in line with the Rwandese/ Dutch specific labour market needs, aiming at inclusivenes
**Output education**
SoL and ILPD have developed new courses, updated their curricula, teaching and learning methods in order to effectively prepare students for the labour market and/or continuous training (bridge the training gap). Skills of lecturers in the provision of general courses and didactics of specialized, gender sensitive courses have improved
**Output Research**
SoL, ILPD have improved their research capacity through joint supervision and training of PhD candidates and upgrade of the quality of the law journal that is jointly published by the partners
**Output Access to Justice**
Access to justice for marginalised groups enhanced through practical training, research and provision of legal aid to marginalised and vulnerable groups
**Output Institutional development**
- Institutional Institutional collaboration between the partners established and strengthened - Organisational development The partner institutions possess the organisational and infrastructural capacity to deliver Competency Based Education and Training (CBET) and practical training in the field of law
**Output Sustainability**
Mechanisms are in place to ensure that uniform standards are applied and maintained to improve the quality of legal education that goes beyond the project duration

Direct target group beneficiaries are: Staff of the Law Departments of the 4 partner institution
Medium term: Students of the Law departments of the 4 partner institutions, people from marginalised groups, women and the society at large

comment.narrative: 04-11-2022: 2 SoL LL.M study programmes have been revised (Business Law and International Criminal Justice & the Law of Human Rights at the School of Law) At ILPD there are 8 courses developed by internal staff that shall be taught to Judges. The developed courses have been submitted to the High Education Council for Accreditation. The JUST project indirectly contributed to the development of those courses, as the revision was done based on teachings of the CBET training. ILPD is in the process of reviewing the Postgraduate programme in Legal Practice (DLP) and the Postgraduate programme in Legislative Drafting (DLD): this will be ready by September 2021 and will therefore be reported on in Y3.

04-12-2020: Due to corona Pandemic the curriculum review for the LLB and LLM programme has been initiated but not yet completed. Other curricula that are potentially ready for revision ILPD the graduate Diploma in Legal Practice and Legislative Drafting are planned to be revised in Year 2.

title.narrative: A.O.6. Number of facilities established/strengthened

comment.narrative:
04-11-2022: Shelves were acquired to furnish the Library of the IILPD that was shifted in the new building. Now all books are on shelves and there is still a space that shall accommodate other books that shall be acquired.
The ILPD Library has a reading area where students can sit and read. The area was equipped with chairs as well as tables and is used by students who wish to read from Library.
The new constructed building of the Institute had two main classes, but the Institute had managed to equip only one class. Now the two classes are equipped with tables and chairs such that conducting parallel intakes or postgraduates’ courses and short courses is possible
The new building of the Institute had a space designed for computer laboratory, but the Institute had not managed to equip the computer laboratory. Now, through JUST project the computer laboratory is being equipped with computers, tables, and chairs. So far only tables and are chairs were delivered, computers are also expected to be delivered in few coming weeks. Once equipped, the computer laboratory shall serve for teaching and research.
The pick-up vehicle was acquired to be used in the implementation of activities of JUST project such as access to justice and quality research. In access to Justice the pickup is to be used to take ILPD Lecturers up countries in dissemination of the law and legal aid. The pickup vehicle shall also intervene in activities of research by taking researchers up countries to collect information. Currently the pick-up vehicle is used in operations of the Institute as activities bring many people together are not allowed due to covid-19 At SoL a Moot Court room has been furnished.
04-12-2020: Investments will be financially reported on in Y2. In the narrative already some information on investments done is included.

title.narrative: A.R.3. Number of relevant innovations

comment.narrative: 04-11-2022: In august 2021 a database developer has been assigned to create a database for CLAM, that will be used for entering data on clients, monitoring outputs of CLAM, increase the efficiency of the organisation, as well as to allow easy acces to information for doing research. The database will be ready in Y3 of the project.
04-12-2020: Mobile clinics have not yet been organised due to COVID-19. Enhancement of mediation services is planned for Y2 of the project.

title.narrative: A.O.8. % of women of teaching staff of faculty/department

comment.narrative: 04-11-2022: In the logframe we indicated that the prognosis is to have 30% of teaching staff to be female in Y3. For Y2 no percentage was included yet. In the baseline of 2019, the percentage at SoL was 13%, at ILPD 14%. There has only been a minor change: the percentage at ILPD has remained the same, at SoL, there are currently 4 female staff and 21 male staff (19% women teaching staff).
04-12-2020: Number of academic staff SoL is 26 post-graduates, 4 females and 21 males. ILPD has 2 male post-doc graduates and 10 PhDs and LLM.

title.narrative: A.E.4. Number of graduates delivered

comment.narrative: 04-12-2020: Realise in SoL equal participation of male and female students in undergraduate courses and scholarship. Currently the ratio is 18%. Of the 10 scholarships initially awarded, 5 were awarded to female students. 2 of them declined the scholarships, due to other reasons. Both PhD scholarships were awarded to male staff, as the female staff could not accept a scholarship due to other (family) obligations).
